Chapter 1

Lit by the product.

LeadQ's promise is an assistant that works while you sleep. So the site lives at night. The darkness is calm and the only bright things on screen are the product doing its job: a message arriving, a booking landing, a call being answered.

Light comes from the app

No decorative gradients floating in empty space. Every glow has a source: a phone, a plan card, a live call. If a light has no product behind it, it gets cut.

Each page has its own color of light

The night base stays constant, but each page gets a signature hue. Blue for home, ice for pricing, purple for voice, and a warm tint per industry. You always know where you are.

Depth means importance

Four layers only: night, surface, glass, lit object. The closer something sits to you, the more it matters. The Growth plan literally floats above the others.

What we took from your references

Not the look, the move. Each reference solves one problem LeadQ also has.

iOS banking app

Conceptzilla

Sky-to-ink gradients, one bold mark, and a white card sliding up over a dark hero.

We use the sky-to-ink fade on the home hero and the "sheet sliding over night" layout for pricing and the app showcase.

Sereno

Mood tracker

One huge, calm sentence over a horizon. A single line that tells a story.

We use it for section openers with one sentence and nothing else, and turn the "emotion line" into a conversation line that traces a lead from first text to booking.

Sentry IoT

Phenomenon studio

Floating pill nav, toggle tiles, and a big physical dial that makes control feel real.

The site nav becomes a floating pill like the app's tab bar. The dial becomes the Voice page centerpiece, filling as minutes are used.

superconscious

Manifestation app

A giant lowercase wordmark behind a tilted phone, a textured glowing object, a pinned waitlist toast.

We put an outlined "leadq" wordmark behind the hero phone, add the dotted orb for depth, and pin a "Try the demo" dock to the corner of every page.

Chapter 2

What we say.

The copy system behind every page. Built from your live site, what the app really does today, and where LeadQ is going: a self-serve product you run yourself, not a service you hire.

The positioning line

One AI assistant for your whole business. It answers every channel and books the appointment while you work.

The problem we name everywhere: the gap between a customer reaching out and someone getting back to them. It happens at midnight, on a Sunday, and in the twenty minutes you were with someone else. That gap is where bookings go to a competitor.

Never miss a lead.

Replies in seconds on WhatsApp, text, web chat, email and the phone. Day, night, weekends. Follows up when a lead goes quiet and texts back missed calls.

What proves itThe live phone in the hero, the demo chat, missed-call text-back, follow-ups.

One assistant, not five tools.

Same persona, same knowledge, same calendar on every channel. Change your hours once and even the phone knows. Voice is not a second robot.

What proves itThe channel orbit, the Voice page, "change it once" copy.

Yours to run.

Set it up from your phone in minutes. Paste your website and it drafts your FAQ and services. You approve, you stay in control, and you can jump into any conversation.

What proves itThree-step setup, pause controls, per-contact AI switch.

9FAQ

Clean accordion. Answers the four questions that stall a signup.

Questions, answered.
What's a credit?

Credits are how LeadQ measures usage. AI conversations, texts, calls and email all draw from one monthly pool, so you never see a separate phone or WhatsApp bill. Run low and you top up in one tap.

Do I need to register for texting?

In the US, business texting needs A2P registration. We guide you through it inside the app. Canada doesn't need it, and the UAE runs on WhatsApp instead.

Can I keep my WhatsApp number?

Yes. Connect a new number or bring the one your customers already message.

Is there a contract?

No. Plans are month to month, and you can cancel whenever you want from inside the app.

Can I take over a conversation?

Any time. Pause the assistant for one contact or a whole channel, reply yourself, then hand it back.

About LeadQ

One app, instead of five tools and a front desk.

LeadQ is one AI assistant for your whole business. It answers WhatsApp, SMS, web chat, email and your phone line, and it books the appointment while you work.

RobCo-founder
AmrCo-founder
2Why we built it

One big sentence, Sereno style, with a short paragraph below.

Every missed message is a job someone else books.

Local businesses lose real money in the gap between a customer reaching out and someone getting back to them. It happens at midnight, on a Sunday, and in the twenty minutes you were with another customer. Missed calls and unread texts don't add up to lost messages. They add up to lost bookings.

3What we believe

Five tool icons collapse into a single LeadQ mark on scroll.

You shouldn't need five tools to answer a customer.

Most small teams stitch together a chat widget, a texting app, an inbox, a booking tool and a receptionist, and still drop messages. It should be one assistant that knows your business, speaks in your voice, and works every channel the same way. So that's what we built.

4What LeadQ is

Three cards, then the closing CTA.

An app you run yourself.

Not an agency. Not a service you wait on. You set it up from your phone in minutes, it learns your services and your tone, and it starts answering. You stay in control, and you can jump into any conversation whenever you want.

Every channelWhatsApp, SMS, web chat, email, and your phone line on Pro.
Books the workChecks real availability, books, reschedules and reminds.
Sounds like youReplies read like your business, not a bot.
